name: oma-space
author: teapot
description: Arrange a Hyprland workspace the way you like it, capture it, and rebuild it on demand — with a bar widget and side panel to see every workspace at a glance.

barWidget.description: The active workspace on the bar; hover it to see what is open there.

schema.label: Widget glyph
schema.description: The character drawn on the bar. Empty uses the built-in workspace glyph.

schema.label: Show the workspace number
schema.description: The number beside the glyph, so the bar says which of the ten you are on. Workspace 10 reads as 0, matching its Super+0 bind.
